_about: Public-domain A. M. Fairbairn (1838-1912), Congregational theologian and first Principal of Mansfield College, Oxford, for the Word Hoard: Studies in the Philosophy of Religion and History (1876), Studies in the Life of Christ (1880), The City of God (1883), The Place of Christ in Modern Theology (1893), Christ in the Centuries (1893) and Religion in History and in Modern Life (1894). Patrick Fairbairn, on the fairbairn shelf, is another man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
